usage: apply_migrations.py [-h]
                           [--inspect-applying-017 | --recover-applying-017 | --inspect-applying-018 | --recover-applying-018 | --inspect-applying-019 | --recover-applying-019 | --inspect-applying-021 | --recover-applying-021 | --inspect-applying-022 | --recover-applying-022 | --inspect-applying-023 | --recover-applying-023 | --inspect-applying-024 | --recover-applying-024 | --inspect-applying-025 | --recover-applying-025]
                           [--apply] [--state-digest STATE_DIGEST]
                           [--expected-database-name EXPECTED_DATABASE_NAME]
                           [--expected-server-uuid EXPECTED_SERVER_UUID]

Apply or inspect Bond Factor Lab schema migrations. Write paths require
explicit --apply authorization.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --inspect-applying-017
                        connect to the live DB and classify an interrupted
                        migration 017 using SELECT plus a named advisory lock
                        only; no DDL/DML
  --recover-applying-017
                        recover migration 017 using --apply and the exact
                        digest from a prior read-only inspection
